contracts: The opt-in save/update body replaces DialogModelHost paragraphs with childless scene text and Rust panel allocation. It reuses the native bubble frame, fixed width, scroll cap and native text insets, and the common scene dialog action client. The Views baseline retains DialogModelHost and native controls.

The account overview uses scene text for profile, empty/error/instruction copy, Rust panel layout and the existing Rust SceneSelect controller/rendering/input adapter. The selector keeps its existing dedicated Metal surface/native popup menu; text and dialog action surfaces are separate. No claim that all password controls share one drawable is made.

Only origins and usernames are projected to text/selector nodes. Password values remain inside Chromium FormManager/PasswordStore results and are never passed to the scene or picker. Save, update, decline, ignore, blocklist/visible-HTTP(S) admission, autofill and profile-scoped stores preserve native authority.

PageServices directly owns widget and delegate, destroys the scene before the widget, and the delegate after it. The Views model host explicitly opts out of native delegate ownership. CloseNow, navigation, hidden pages and WebContents destruction dismiss the UI and ignore a pending form at most once.

A separate weak factory invalidates pending password-store reads and UI close callbacks on dismissal, without invalidating the long-lived Chromium client callbacks. Repeated overview commands coalesce while a read is pending. The overview keeps its nonmodal, draggable/resizable native frame and screen-constrained placement.

The existing real Chromium save/fill/update test now checks actual Cocoa Escape decline, focused Space save and Return update after successful native presentation. It checks scene visibility, metadata and childless actions while preserving real storage, autofill, hidden-page cancellation and cross-profile isolation assertions.

A shared browser case populates two real store accounts, checks account AX metadata and absence of the synthetic secret, actual Cocoa prefix input/Escape, CloseNow destruction/reopen, a pending read followed by profile hiding, empty personal-profile copy and navigation dismissal. Existing overview placement and common dialog/download/folder/workspace/tool/preference regressions also run.

No dependency, service policy or license component was added. Native window/frame/scroll/View/Button/focus/AX ownership, remaining password UI copy/coordination and full platform/manual/performance/release acceptance remain open.
